about.title: Greenfield Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Greenfield sees its share of collisions on corridors like Oak Avenue, El Camino Real, Elm Avenue, and Walnut Avenue, with reported crashes tending to cluster on Saturday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. In a recent year, the city recorded 25 injury collisions and 27 people injured. Behind each of those numbers is someone dealing with medical bills, missed work, and a lot of uncertainty about what comes next. LawProactive doesn't practice law — we're a free service that connects you with an independent personal injury attorney who can review your situation, explain your options under California law, and handle communications with insurance companies on your behalf. Whether your crash happened at a busy Greenfield intersection or on a quieter stretch of road, getting matched with someone who understands local conditions and Monterey County procedures can make the process less overwhelming.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before Dealing With Insurance

items.title: California's Deadline Is Shorter Than You Think
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a claim, but if a government entity (like a city road defect) contributed to your accident, that window can shrink to as little as six months. Missing it can end your case before it starts, so early guidance matters.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Reduce — Not Erase — Your Claim
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you were partly responsible for the crash, though your share of fault reduces the amount. An attorney can help make sure fault isn't overstated against you.

items.title: Recorded Statements Can Work Against You
items.desc: Insurance adjusters often ask for a recorded statement soon after a crash, but anything you say can be used to minimize your claim later. An independent attorney can advise you on what to share and help preserve evidence like photos, witness contacts, and crash reports before they disappear.

items.question: How much does it cost to get connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only collect a fee if you recover compensation. There's no upfront cost or obligation to move forward.

items.question: I was in a crash on El Camino Real in Greenfield — do I need to talk to the other driver's insurance company right away?
items.answer: You're not required to give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer, and it's often wiser to hold off until you've spoken with an attorney. Insurers sometimes use early statements to shift blame or downplay injuries. Getting matched with an attorney first can help protect your position.

items.question: What if the crash happened at a Greenfield intersection with no clear fault?
items.answer: California's comparative fault rules allow you to pursue compensation even in situations where fault seems shared or unclear. An attorney can help gather evidence — like traffic camera footage, witness statements, or the police report — to establish what actually happened. Acting quickly matters, since evidence and memories fade over time.
